segments.title: Closing your last window keeps it
segments.body: Pinned tabs, five open tabs and a Weekend group; the red button, then Ardia in the Dock. nightly.3 asked "Close 5 tabs?" and the Dock gave a fresh window with only the pins; now it closes without asking and comes back as it was.
segments.note: Before's warning drawn from what nightly.3 logged

segments.title: Profile icons get room in the switcher
segments.body: Five profiles with "Show profile icons instead of dots" on, a hover on School and a click on Music. nightly.3 packed each icon into an 18 pt cell, so the targets touched; now each gets 26 pt.
